name: LootboxEnchantRoll - Join Entry (seed v1)
description: One enchantment that items from a lootbox type may get, with its chance and levels. Created from the type's Enchantment rolls step (Create New Join Entry).

steps.description: Each roll is tried once per opened item. Enchantment books and stackable items never get rolled enchantments; an item keeps its default enchantments when they are higher.

fields.label: Enchantment
fields.description: Vanilla enchantments are also capped by the item's grade; custom ones only by their own maximum level.

fields.label: Chance (%)
fields.description: Chance that an item gets this enchantment, 0-100 (up to 4 decimals).

fields.label: Maximum level
fields.description: Highest level rolled, at most the enchantment's maximum level. The level is picked evenly between minimum and maximum.

fields.label: From box grade (stars)
fields.description: Only boxes with at least this many stars (1-10) roll this enchantment.

fields.label: Order
fields.description: Rolls are tried from low to high; a later hit that conflicts with an earlier enchantment is skipped. Steps of 10 leave room to insert one.
